Hear-say

Hear-say is half lies.
German.
I saw a man, who saw another man, who saw the sea.
Portuguese.
Sight goes before hear-say.
Danish.
To have “heard say” is half a lie.
Italian.
One eye-witness is better than ten hear-says.
